parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit) that makes a
retried request safe. The service always runs on Postgres, so it is
required on every deployment and answered with 400
`idempotency-key-required` when absent; a replay with the same key and
the same request (method, path and body) returns the original response
with the header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`, while the same key with a
different request is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. A key longer than 128
characters is also 400 `idempotency-key-required`. A 2xx answer is
stored and replayed. Of the refusals, every problem type has one
replay class (ADR 0014): a FINAL one (the request-shaped 400s, 404
`replenishment-not-found`, 409 `replenishment-not-open`) is stored and
replayed like a success; a RETRYABLE one (`concurrent-modification`,
`replenishment-already-open`, `no-forward-assignment`, `no-policy`,
`no-source-stock`, `nothing-to-replenish`, `quantity-exceeds-max`) is
not stored and its key is released, so the same key may be sent again
once the cause changed, and a different body under it is a new request;
a 5xx is never stored.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: The site id (the facility site code).
